text:
Alex Chen: Kickoff drop: Orion Retail starts onboarding Mon 2026-04-06. Need final stakeholder contacts, clear owners for infra/enablement/billing, and the definition of success for the first 14 days. Any early renewal flags? @Marco Ruiz @Dana Lee @Priya Patel

Marco Ruiz: From intake: Lina Torres (Head Product), Omar Haddad (Infra), Jess Carter (Data Ops). Finance lead still TBD. CSM noted a budget review ~45 days out 15 - flag as a potential churn risk.

Priya Patel: Ib4ll run enablement (docs + live workshop). Plan: 45-60m session covering console flow, common errors, and integration patterns. Will post an agenda later today. Prefer to do product walkthrough first to align stakeholders.

Dana Lee: Ib4ll own technical onboarding: env prep, API key provisioning, test payload ingestion, and smoke tests. For Private deployment we need the network owner's name + approved IP ranges. Will share a pre-onboard checklist tomorrow.

Alex Chen: Draft 14-day success checklist: a) end-to-end staging smoke with median generation latency under 250ms; b) 8-12 representative prompts meet our quality gate (<=5% fail rate); c) three engineers have console access and can run the quick test; d) billing baseline and quota sanity-check completed. Suggestions?

Marco Ruiz: Looks good. Add: lock initial model to rw-v1.3 for rollout stability and require a data privacy signoff if any prompts include customer PII. Also include a short runbook for high-latency responses.

Priya Patel: Agree. I'll include troubleshooting flows and a 3-question feedback form to capture enablement sentiment.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "Orion - Onboarding Workshop" Thu 2026-04-09 16:00 UTC 1 - https://calendar.example/evt/24680 :calendar:

Dana Lee: Pre-onboard checklist (draft): - Provide service account + API key - Supply IP allowlist entries for staging - Upload sample payloads and schema - Grant console access to 3 engineers - Put test prompt set in shared drive

Quick curl for devs to sanity-check env:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-v1.3","prompt":"<sanity test>","max_tokens":64}'
```

Alex Chen: Who will own the 14-day health summary (KPIs + blockers + renewal signal + recommended actions)? Need a short one-pager and a 15-min readout.

Marco Ruiz: Ib4ll take the health summary. Ib4ll include metrics to track: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, quality pass %, integration blockers, and a renewal signal row. Will have a draft by day 12.

Priya Patel: Ib4ll synthesize the enablement feedback and add notes to the playbook. Will share the feedback form results within 24h of the session.

Alex Chen: Good. Cadence: workshop Thu, quick go/no-go check Friday. Also added the 45-day budget review to the Renewal Signals sheet as a medium risk; mitigation options: exec intro, extra usage reporting, and an adoption roadmap.

Omar Haddad: Quick ask from infra: we need an SLA exceptions doc for initial throughput limits and an estimated token/day profile. Ib4ll follow up with Marco on values.

Dana Lee: Shared drive created and checklist uploaded: https://drive.example/folder/orion-starter. Also added a contacts doc for firewall and network owners.

Alex Chen: Thanks team. Ib4ll update the onboarding playbook with owners and next steps and ping everyone for any missing contacts.
